dog.description_text:
A volunteer writes:
Patches is a handsome and pristine cow-print young cat who is with us as his owner moved to a place not allowing pets. His housemate was rehomed and not brought with him. Patches who seems to have been very well care for is known to be a shy cat who hides easily from people and other pets. He would as well be caring and affectionate according to his former owner. Patches has been avoidant while at the care center, staying 100% at the back of his cubby. Recently, Patches has been accepting churrus, coming forward to sample treats but still avoiding to be petted by hand. It is a step forward, though and we are hoping that more interactions with staff and volunteers will get Patches out of his shell and on his way to his new home(low traffic, no young children) and family(patient, understanding and exerienced new owners). Patches is waiting for his forever at the Manhattan Care Center!
dog.name: Patches
